# LegSmart

> LegSmart is a specialized retailer of medical-grade and athletic compression socks from leading brands including Sigvaris, Juzo, Mediven, and CEP, with 30 years of expertise in compression therapy and certified fitting services.

LegSmart offers a comprehensive selection of compression stockings for medical conditions, sports recovery, and everyday wellness. The site features detailed sizing guides, FAQs about compression therapy benefits, and collections organized by gender, fit, brand, and health condition.

- Compression socks

- DVT prevention

- [Sigvaris Well Being](https://www.legsmart.com/collections/well-being): Sigvaris Well Being collection with casual cotton and athletic recovery options.
